reden: Yes. The report flags MonetrixVault.reclaimFromRedeemEscrow() as lacking access control (no onlyOperator/onlyGovernor), making it callable by anyone and enabling unauthorized fund movements. The vulnerability description is the same: missing onlyOperator on reclaimFromRedeemEscrow so any address can call it. Same function, same root cause (missing access control), same impact/attack path, and same fix (add proper access control such as onlyOperator).
